last.verdict: Profit beat, but a weaker sales outlook for next year weighed on shares.

reasons.label: Weak revenue outlook
reasons.text: Next year's sales are forecast to fall about 1%, versus the roughly 1.4% growth analysts expected.

reasons.label: International stores lag
reasons.text: International same-store sales rose just 0.9% and customer transactions fell 2.8%, while U.S. sales rose 7.7%.

reasons.label: Profit beat, buyback ahead
reasons.text: Adjusted profit was $0.80 a share versus about $0.72 expected; 2027 forecast is $3.15–$3.25.

story: Starbucks' turnaround has built momentum, with U.S. sales growth strengthening and profit forecasts raised through the year. The worry has shifted to overall revenue and weak international trends. Reactions have been muted: shares rose only 1.6% after July's big beat and slipped this time.

history.verdict: Big beat and a sharply raised profit outlook, but the stock rose only modestly.

reasons.label: Profit outlook raised
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted earnings forecast lifted to $2.55–$2.65 a share, from $2.25–$2.45.

reasons.label: Strong sales growth
reasons.text: Same-store sales rose 7.9% worldwide, with 4.2% more customer transactions.

reasons.label: Earnings crushed estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted profit was $0.85 a share versus roughly $0.66 expected.
